dedupe_keys.name: brazzaville vegetable wholesale and retail supply flow survey 2022

description: This dataset traces vegetable supplies to retail and wholesale markets in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. CIRAD and local university researchers surveyed traders during rainy and dry seasons in 2022, recording sixteen vegetables, quantities, prices and sourcing locations. Coverage includes fourteen retail markets and seven wholesale markets, with some sites in both groups. CIRAD Dataverse provides two CSV datasets, a variable dictionary and README free under CC BY-NC 4.0. One survey day per season limits inference about annual flows or seasonal variability. The repository country field incorrectly names the Democratic Republic of the Congo, while its title, description and article identify Brazzaville in the Republic of the Congo; its 2023 time-period field also conflicts with the stated 2022 collection dates. These inconsistencies are retained. Modellers could construct food-distribution or accessibility simulations. platform-global-food-twin is a related food-flow platform at a different scale. No trader records were downloaded or market totals recalculated.
name: Brazzaville vegetable wholesale and retail supply-flow survey, 2022
notes: G2-0482. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed. Repository country and time-period fields conflict with its narrative and article; Republic of the Congo and 2022 are used with the discrepancies preserved.
